meta.name_zh: 98 年國民健康訪問暨藥物濫用調查
meta.data_description_zh:
1. 國民健康訪問調查(National Health Interview Survey，簡稱NHIS)已被公認為監測國
民健康現況及變化趨勢之重要方法，在台灣，每隔四年進行一次的「國民健康訪問
調查」已先後完成 2001年與2005年兩次調查工作。其中，2001年鑒於國內外非法
藥物與成癮物質濫用情形有日益嚴重趨勢，考量其對健康之不良影響，2005年首次
加入藥物與毒品等成癮物質的問題，並將調查擴大為「國民健康訪問暨藥物濫用調
查」。
2. 此次調查繼續沿用 2005 年之架構，分為個人基本資料、個人健康狀況、疾病預防
知識、醫療服務利用、個人健康行為、自覺健康狀態及工作與經濟狀況等七大項，
並徵詢國內健康訪問調查專家等對問卷的增修意見，分別對三份主問卷內容做出調
整之建議。其中，「飲酒」、「食物攝取、飲食型態」以及「工作狀況」題組重新修
訂，「商業保險利用」題組刪除，並新增「心理健康(CES-D量表)」、「EQ-5D量表」、
「健康識能」、「網路醫療服務利用」等五大項「附加題組」等，而舊有「民俗療法
使用情形」題組，此次將列入附加題組中，並僅限未滿 12歲問卷中填答。
3. 本次調查的區域範圍為台灣地區 23個縣市，對象以 2008年12月 31日在台灣設有
戶籍，具有中華民國國籍之人口，但不包括軍事單位、醫療院所、學校、職訓中心、
宿舍、監獄等機構內的居民，以及居住國外者，中選樣本（人）即為受訪對象。抽
樣底冊是行政院衛生署資訊中心提供 2008 年 12 月 31 日的「台灣地區個人戶籍資
料檔」(總人口數為 22,942,706人)。
(引述國民健康訪問暨藥物濫用調查工作團隊結果報告說明)
meta.notes_zh:
1. 本手冊僅提供三份不同年齡層之主問卷資料檔說明，分別為未滿 12歲、12-64歲、
及 65 歲以上，依序為檔案 S_BHP_NHISA_2009、S_BHP_NHISB_2009、
S_BHP_NHISC_2009。
meta.name_zh_from_listing: 資料庫使用手冊Society10-98年國民健康訪問暨藥物濫用調查
meta.data_description_en:
1. The National Health Interview Survey (NHIS) is recognized as an important method for monitoring the current status and trends of national health. In Taiwan, the NHIS, conducted once every four years, has completed two rounds of surveys in 2001 and 2005. In 2001, in view of the increasingly serious trend of illegal drug and substance abuse both domestically and internationally, and considering its adverse health effects, questions on drugs and other addictive substances were added for the first time in 2005, expanding the survey into the "National Health Interview and Drug Abuse Survey."
2. This survey continues to use the 2005 framework, divided into seven major sections: personal basic information, personal health status, disease-prevention knowledge, medical-service utilization, personal health behavior, self-perceived health status, and work and economic status. Opinions on revising the questionnaire were solicited from domestic NHIS experts, resulting in adjustment recommendations for the three main questionnaires. Among these, the "alcohol consumption," "food intake and dietary pattern," and "work status" modules were revised, the "commercial insurance utilization" module was removed, and five new "supplementary modules" were added: "mental health (CES-D scale)," "EQ-5D scale," "health literacy," and "internet medical-service utilization," among others; the previous "folk-remedy use" module was moved into the supplementary modules this time, and is answered only in the under-12 questionnaire.
3. The survey area covered 23 counties/cities in Taiwan Area. The target population consisted of people who held household registration in Taiwan and Republic of China nationality as of December 31, 2008, excluding residents of military units, medical institutions, schools, vocational training centers, dormitories, prisons, and similar institutions, as well as those living abroad; the selected sample individuals were the survey respondents. The sampling frame was the "Taiwan Area Individual Household Registration Data File" as of December 31, 2008, provided by the Department of Health Information Center, Executive Yuan (total population: 22,942,706).
(Quoted from the results report of the National Health Interview and Drug Abuse Survey working team)
meta.notes_en: 1. This manual provides descriptions of only three main-questionnaire data files for different age groups: under 12, 12-64, and 65 and older, corresponding respectively to files S_BHP_NHISA_2009, S_BHP_NHISB_2009, and S_BHP_NHISC_2009.

meta.data_description_zh:
1. 國民健康訪問調查(National Health Interview Survey，簡稱NHIS)已被公認為監測
國民健康現況及變化趨勢之重要方法，在台灣，每隔四年進行一次的「國民健康
訪問調查」已先後完成 2001 年、2005 年及 2009 年三次調查工作。其中，2001
年鑒於國內外非法藥物與成癮物質濫用情形有日益嚴重趨勢，考量其對健康之不
良影響，2005 年首次加入藥物與毒品等成癮物質的問題，並將調查擴大為「國民
健康訪問暨藥物濫用調查」，且自2005 年起由家戶為抽樣單位改以個人為抽樣單
位，而2009 年調查大致承襲2005年模式。
2. 本次調查主要係延續 2009 年調查之架構，因 2005 年與 2009 年兩次附加藥物濫
用自填問卷之資料分析結果，完訪樣本之藥物濫用行為機率約 1.5%，其樣本數並
不足以進一步探討不同年齡層藥物濫用民眾之行為，故國人藥物濫用盛行率之自
填問卷，不納入 2013 年「國民健康訪問調查」之調查。2013 年「國民健康訪問
調查」內容分為個人基本資料、個人健康狀況、疾病預防知識、醫療與預防保健
服務利用情形、個人健康行為、自覺健康狀態及工作與經濟狀況等七大項，及附
加題組包含「心理健康(CES-D量表)」、「自覺健康狀態（SF36）」、「EQ-5D量表」、
「中醫資源接受程度」、「中藥使用情形」等附加題組。
(引述國民健康訪問暨藥物濫用調查工作團隊結果報告說明)
meta.notes_zh:
1. 本手冊提供三份不同年齡層之主問卷資料檔說明，分別為未滿 12 歲、12-64 歲、
及 65 歲以上，依序為檔案 S_BHP_NHISA_2013、S_BHP_NHISB_2013、
S_BHP_NHISC_2013。
2. 檔案S_BHP_NHISCOV_2013 提供主問卷之完訪樣本資訊，資料來源處刪除餘資
料檔部分樣本。
※本中心資料庫業經去識別化處理，刪除姓名、地址等可直接識別欄位，如有身分
證字號、院所代碼、投保單位代號、統一編號、出生日期、就醫日期、入院日期等
欄位均經屏蔽處理，且相關資料僅能於本部設置之獨立作業區內使用，並攜出經審
核通過之統計結果，以確保資料應用及其揭露方式已無從識別特定當事人。
meta.name_zh_from_listing: 資料庫使用手冊Society10-102年國民健康訪問調查檔
meta.data_description_en:
1. The National Health Interview Survey (NHIS) is recognized as an important method for monitoring the current status and trends of national health. In Taiwan, the NHIS, conducted once every four years, has completed three rounds of surveys in 2001, 2005, and 2009. In 2001, in view of the increasingly serious trend of illegal drug and substance abuse both domestically and internationally, and considering its adverse health effects, questions on drugs and other addictive substances were added for the first time in 2005, expanding the survey into the "National Health Interview and Drug Abuse Survey." Also starting in 2005, the sampling unit changed from the household to the individual, and the 2009 survey largely followed the 2005 model.
2. This survey mainly continues the framework of the 2009 survey. Because analysis of the self-administered drug-abuse supplementary questionnaires from 2005 and 2009 found that the probability of drug-abuse behavior among completed-interview samples was only about 1.5%, the sample size was insufficient to further examine drug-abuse behavior across different age groups. Therefore, the self-administered questionnaire on the prevalence of drug abuse among the population was not included in the 2013 NHIS. The 2013 NHIS content is divided into seven major sections: personal basic information, personal health status, disease-prevention knowledge, utilization of medical and preventive-care services, personal health behavior, self-perceived health status, and work and economic status, along with supplementary modules covering "mental health (CES-D scale)," "self-perceived health status (SF-36)," "EQ-5D scale," "degree of acceptance of traditional Chinese medicine resources," and "use of traditional Chinese medicine," among others.
(Quoted from the results report of the National Health Interview and Drug Abuse Survey working team)
meta.notes_en:
1. This manual provides descriptions of the main-questionnaire data files for three different age groups: under 12, 12-64, and 65 and older, corresponding respectively to files S_BHP_NHISA_2013, S_BHP_NHISB_2013, and S_BHP_NHISC_2013.
2. The file S_BHP_NHISCOV_2013 provides information on the completed-interview sample for the main questionnaire; the data source has removed some samples from the remaining data files.
※ This center's database has been de-identified: directly identifying fields such as name and address have been removed, and fields such as ID number, facility code, insured unit code, tax ID number, date of birth, visit date, and admission date have been masked. The data may only be used within the independent workspace established by the Ministry, and only approved aggregate statistical results may be taken out, ensuring that the data and its disclosure method can no longer identify specific individuals.

meta.data_description_en:
1. The National Health Interview Survey (NHIS) is recognized as an important method for monitoring the current status and trends of national health. In Taiwan, the NHIS, conducted once every four years, has completed five rounds of surveys in 2001, 2005, 2009, 2013, and 2017. In 2001, in view of the increasingly serious trend of illegal drug and substance abuse both domestically and internationally, and considering its adverse health effects, questions on drugs and other addictive substances were added for the first time in 2005, expanding the survey into the "National Health Interview and Drug Abuse Survey." Also starting in 2005, the sampling unit changed from the household to the individual; the 2009 survey first introduced "optional modules" and the "Computer-Assisted Personal Interviewing (CAPI) system," increasing the convenience of face-to-face interviews, data-entry efficiency, and data quality.
2. The sixth NHIS was conducted from 2021 to 2022 (ROC years 110-111), expanding the survey area to include Kinmen and Lienchiang counties. This survey mainly continues the data-collection model established since 2009, using computer-assisted methods for community face-to-face interviews and self-administered questionnaires, and builds on the computer-assisted survey information system developed for the 2013 survey, with system enhancements, new features, and corrections, applied to this community health survey.
3. This survey used household registration data as the sampling frame. Based on regional population characteristics and administrative and cost considerations for survey implementation, individuals were sampled in Taiwan Area (including Penghu County), while in Kinmen and Lienchiang counties, households were used as the sampling unit, with a full census of the actual resident population of the selected address households. Interviewers used the computer-assisted personal interviewing system to conduct questionnaire surveys in each sample area. Considering differences in health issues across age groups, three types of questionnaires were designed—under 12, 12-64, and 65 and older—combining core questions with supplementary modules to increase the data items collected in each questionnaire. Fieldwork was conducted from October to December 2021 (ROC year 110) and from July to November 2022 (ROC year 111); the number of completed interviews was 24,304 in Taiwan Area, and 800 and 589 in Kinmen County and Lienchiang County, respectively.
(Quoted from the results report of the National Health Interview and Drug Abuse Survey working team)

meta.data_description_zh:
1. 國民健康訪問調查(National Health Interview Survey，簡稱 NHIS)已被公認為監測國
民健康現況及變化趨勢之重要方法，在台灣，每隔四年進行一次的「國民健康訪問
調查」已先後完成 2001 年、2005 年、2009 年、2013 年及 2017 年共五次調查工
作。其中，2001 年鑒於國內外非法藥物與成癮物質濫用情形有日益嚴重趨勢，考
量其對健康之不良影響，2005 年首次加入藥物與毒品等成癮物質的問題，並將調
查擴大為「國民健康訪問暨藥物濫用調查」，且自2005年起由家戶為抽樣單位改以
個人為抽樣單位，2009 年調查中初次導入「附加題組」(optional module)方式及「電
腦輔助面訪調查系統(CAPI)」，增加面訪之便利性、建檔效率與資料品質。
2. 於民國 2021 年至 2022 年辦理第六次國民健康訪問調查，並擴大將金門與連江兩
縣納入調查區域範圍。本次調查主要係延續 2009年以來所建立之調查資料蒐集模
式，以電腦輔助調查方式進行樣本個案之社區面訪與問卷自填，並以 2013 年調查
所開發之電腦輔助調查資訊系統為基礎，進行系統建置、功能新增與修正後，運用
於本次之社區民眾健康調查。
3. 本次調查以戶籍登記資料為抽樣母體清冊，依地區人口特性與調查執行之行政與
成本考量，分別於臺灣地區(含澎湖縣)以個人為抽樣單位抽選，並於金門和連江兩
縣以家戶為抽樣單位進行中選地址戶之實住人口全查。調查方式由訪問員運用電
腦輔助面訪調查系統，於各樣本區進行問卷訪查。考量不同年齡層之健康問題差
異，設計未滿 12歲、12至64歲以及 65歲以上三類問卷，結合運用核心問題與附
加題組，增加各卷可蒐集資料項目。實地訪查期間自 110年 10月至12月及111 年
7月至11月，臺灣地區完訪案數為 24,304人，金門縣及連江縣分別完訪 800人及
589人。
(引述國民健康訪問暨藥物濫用調查工作團隊結果報告說明)
meta.notes_zh:
1. 臺灣地區、金門縣及連江縣採用不同抽樣設計與抽樣單位，後續加權方式也不同
(詳 2021 年國民健康訪問調查結果報告)，請勿將臺灣地區、金門縣及連江縣調查
資料合併分析。為避免誤將資料檔合併分析，臺灣地區、金門縣、連江縣資料分開

meta.data_description_en:
1. The National Health Interview Survey (NHIS) is recognized as an important method for monitoring the current status and trends of national health. In Taiwan, the NHIS, conducted once every four years, has completed five rounds of surveys in 2001, 2005, 2009, 2013, and 2017. In 2001, in view of the increasingly serious trend of illegal drug and substance abuse both domestically and internationally, and considering its adverse health effects, questions on drugs and other addictive substances were added for the first time in 2005, expanding the survey into the "National Health Interview and Drug Abuse Survey." Also starting in 2005, the sampling unit changed from the household to the individual; the 2009 survey first introduced "optional modules" and the "Computer-Assisted Personal Interviewing (CAPI) system," increasing the convenience of face-to-face interviews, data-entry efficiency, and data quality.
2. The sixth NHIS was conducted from 2021 to 2022 (ROC years 110-111), expanding the survey area to include Kinmen and Lienchiang counties. This survey mainly continues the data-collection model established since 2009, using computer-assisted methods for community face-to-face interviews and self-administered questionnaires, and builds on the computer-assisted survey information system developed for the 2013 survey, with system enhancements, new features, and corrections, applied to this community health survey.
3. This survey used household registration data as the sampling frame. Based on regional population characteristics and administrative and cost considerations for survey implementation, individuals were sampled in Taiwan Area (including Penghu County), while in Kinmen and Lienchiang counties, households were used as the sampling unit, with a full census of the actual resident population of the selected address households. Interviewers used the computer-assisted personal interviewing system to conduct questionnaire surveys in each sample area. Considering differences in health issues across age groups, three types of questionnaires were designed—under 12, 12-64, and 65 and older—combining core questions with supplementary modules to increase the data items collected in each questionnaire. Fieldwork was conducted from October to December 2021 (ROC year 110) and from July to November 2022 (ROC year 111); the number of completed interviews was 24,304 in Taiwan Area, and 800 and 589 in Kinmen County and Lienchiang County, respectively.
(Quoted from the results report of the National Health Interview and Drug Abuse Survey working team)
meta.notes_en: 1.
